reviews.author: Guest
reviews.title: Een heerlijk comfortabel huis op een geweldig eiland.
reviews.positive: Doordat we prachtig weer hadden hebben we de meeste tijd doorgebracht rond het zwembad en in de buitenkeuken. Een geweldige ruimte om te relaxen, te barbecueën en te eten. Door de enorme schuifpuien een echt buitengevoel en als het ‘s avonds toch wat afkoelt of gaat waaien kun je gemakkelijk wat meer beschutting creëren.
reviews.negative: De verlichting is vrij fel en koel en niet dimbaar. Om het gezellig te houden hebben we waxinelichtjes aangezet en ook wat nachtlampjes in de buitenkeuken gezet.

reviews.author: Guest
reviews.title: Ótimo
reviews.positive: Ligging en rust en de uitrusting in het huis, en zwembad

reviews.title: Однозначно рекомендую!
reviews.positive:
Шикарна вілла у тихому районі містечка Кальєта. Мушу сказати, що це одне з найкомфортніших та найзатишніших помешкань в яких я коли-небудь бувала. 
Продумано все до деталей.
Вілла розрахована на велику компанію, кухні є аж три: гостьова, робоча та в барбекю зоні. Кохане приладдя є все необхідне і навіть більше.

reviews.comment: Uma villa luxuosa numa zona tranquila da cidade de Calheta. Devo dizer que este é um dos alojamentos mais confortáveis e acolhedores em que já estive. Tudo foi pensado ao mínimo detalhe. A villa foi projetada para um grupo grande, com três...

reviews.author: Konstantin
reviews.title: Group trip
reviews.comment:
Beautiful villa. Great view over the ocean. Nice pool. Had everything we needed to cook and bbq.
Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Bandar
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment:
The worst part and a spoiler was to wait for cleaners to finish well after the checking in time of 4.0pm. 
They left after 5.0pm
I consider that to be very disrespectful and unprofessional.
reviews.response:
Dear Bandar.
We would like to clarify your review, as it does not accurately reflect what happened.
You attempted to access the property well before the official check-in time and without our authorisation. When you later returned to the property, at approximately 17h00 the cleaning team was already leaving with their vehicle. Therefore, it is not accurate to state that you had to wait for the cleaning team to finish, as you attempted to enter the property before the official check-in time.
Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Group trip
reviews.comment:
Amazing place to stay!! I would definitely recommend for a a family trip here! The rooms were all beautiful and 3 out of the 4 had balcony access. 
The view was also wonderful! Vistas of the ocean and a small pasture below. This made for a wonderful time outside swimming, cooking (in the outdoor kitchen), or relaxing. 
Overall, it was a wonderful experience and I would recommend this place to everyone! The host was also very responsive. 
Also, about 15 mins to ponta do sol and about 35 mins to Funchal. Calheta had a couple of great places to eat and had a grocery store as well!
reviews.response:
Dear David. 
We would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude for taking the time to share such a delightful review of your recent stay at Villa de la Ponte. Your kind words have truly brightened our day, and we are thrilled to hear about your positive experience.
We are delighted that you made the most of the property’s spaces and enjoyed the swimming pool and outdoor cooking, taking full advantage of the beautiful Madeira weather.
Thank you once again for your feedback. We hope to welcome you back in the future!
Warm regards,
Atlantic Holidays.

reviews.author: Bogdan
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment:
Absolutely amazing villa, straight out of MTV Cribs, that was so beautiful that we barely wanted to leave and explore the island. 
We were a group of 5 adults and 3 children (aged between 10 months and 6 years) and had an unforgettable 5 days at the villa. 
The photos on Airbnb don’t do the place justice as it is much more beautiful in real life. 
The host was more than helpful all stay long, super quick to respond to all our questions, needs and few requests. 
This villa deserves more than the 5 stars allowed, we will recommend it to all our friends and we will return for sure!
reviews.response:
Dear Bogdan.
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We are thrilled to hear that you and your group had an unforgettable stay at our villa and that it felt like something straight out of MTV Cribs! 
It’s fantastic to know that the whole group, including the little ones, enjoyed their time here. We always aim to make our guests feel at home, and we’re so glad to hear our hospitality met your expectations. Your kind words about the beauty of the villa and the helpfulness of the team mean a lot to us.
We truly appreciate your recommendation and can’t wait to welcome you back for another amazing stay in the future!
Warm regards,
Atlantic Holiday.
